AndroidX Test monitor 1.7.2 test fixtures

are derived from androidx.test:monitor:1.7.2, published by Google, whose source
files bear the following notices:

Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0. A copy is supplied in

exercise a separately documented two-byte metadata correction.
